_comment: Shared enums for playbook fields (build-prompt audit fix #7). All playbook data files must reference these exact string values — never invent a new string inline (e.g. 'high' vs 'High' vs 'HIGH') since the dashboard filters (Phase 14 equivalent) depend on exact matches.
category: Windows System Log - Service Control Manager & Event Log Service
_extension_policy: To add a category or integration value not listed here, add it to this file first (and update this comment's rationale if needed). Do not let values fragment across individual playbook JSON files.
